question: How are the knowers divided and what happens to those with trembling knowledge at death?
premises: The knowers here are divided twofold into trembling and other.
Among them are those whose knowledge is of the trembling kind.
Those trembling knowers clearly become Shivas at the end of the body.
inference: Even knowers whose realization is still unstable attain the state of Shiva at the time of death.
uncertainties: The exact nature of 'trembling knowledge' (kampravijñāna) is explained in the following verses.
plain_english: But the knowers here are twofold, divided into trembling and other. Among them, those whose knowledge is trembling clearly become Shivas at the end of the body.
